option.value:
version: '3.8'
services: mysql: image: mysql:8.0 container_name: mysql-usuarios environment: MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: 123456 MYSQL_DATABASE: msvc_usuarios ports: - "3307:3306" volumes: - mysql-data:/var/lib/mysql
msvc-usuarios: build: context: ./msvc-usuarios dockerfile: Dockerfile container_name: msvc-usuarios ports: - "8001:8001" environment: SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL: jdbc:mysql://mysql:3306/msvc_usuarios?useSSL=false&serverTimezone=UTC SPRING_DATASOURCE_USERNAME: root SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD: 123456 depends_on: - mysql networks: - microservicios-network
postgresql: image: postgres:15-alpine container_name: postgres-cursos environment: POSTGRES_PASSWORD: 123456 POSTGRES_DB: msvc_cursos ports: - "5432:5432" volumes: - postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
msvc-cursos: build: context: . dockerfile: ./msvc-cursos/Dockerfile container_name: msvc-cursos ports: - "8002:8002" environment: SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL: jdbc:postgresql://postgresql:5432/msvc_cursos SPRING_DATASOURCE_USERNAME: postgres SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD: 123456 depends_on: - postgresql networks: - microservicios-network
volumes: mysql-data: postgres-data:
networks: microservicios-network: driver: bridge
